blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) said on Tuesday that it had ordered all police unitsacrossMetro Manila to intensify security preparations for possible developments in Vice PresidentSara Duterte’simpeachment trial. NCRPO chief Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano said he directed all district directors, unit commanders, and concerned personnel to heighten their security, situational monitoring, as well as ensure there is enough police visibility within their respective jurisdictions.
